extracted.name: Crispy Fluffy Pancakes
extracted.description: My Crispy Fluffy Pancakes are a breakfast dream—golden edges, pillowy centers, and just the right amount of sweetness. Made with simple pantry staples, these pancakes strike the perfect balance between light and rich, with a buttery vanilla flavor and satisfying crisp on the outside.
ingredient_lines: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, melted and slightly cooled
instruction_lines: In a large bowl whisk flour, sugar, baking powder and sea salt. Set aside.
In a medium bowl whisk milk and egg, then add melted butter and vanilla extract. Stir to combine.
Add wet ingredients to flour mixture and combine with a spatula (note: the batter will be thick).
Heat frying pan on medium low heat, then add about 1 teaspoon coconut.
Once melted add ¼ cup of batter and cook until bubbles near the center start to pop, flip then cook for about another 30 seconds.
Repeat adding more oil as needed.
